patthana23.41:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na vipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho vipāko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.41:2.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na vipākadhammadhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho vipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.41:3.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho nevavipākanavipākadhammadhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekavīsa. nasanidassanattika naupādinnupādāniyattike sanidassanattika upādinnupādāniyattikaṃ
